title: Symbol Message · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Symbol Message · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a simple phrase such as making breakfast. The lead communicates the phrase using drawn symbols without letters or numbers. The others guess the phrase. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Symbol Message, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
